en.tooltip_fake: Should the fake versions be available in the game?
en.sgns60_desc: The Sgns 60 is a container wagon for intermodal transport with a length of 19.74 m. This wagon has a loading length of 60 ft and can therefore be loaded with containers according to the ISO standard as well as with the European 30 ft container.
en.sgssy2_desc: Sgss(-y) 703 are container wagons for PIC (Parcel Intercity) high-speed traffic
